name: omnisense/omniplay
description: Omniplay: online play for games on the platform side, under any PHP host and whatever the game's engine or netcode - a fleet of game servers kept by their heartbeats, a player seated on a fitting server with a short-lived signed ticket the server checks by itself, hosting providers that start and stop servers, behind contracts by capability. Providers are packages of their own (omniplay/docker); the ticket's format and its vectors are documented for a server in any language to check.

suggest.omniplay/docker: Docker: game-server containers started and stopped through the Docker Engine API (a unix socket or TCP)
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omniplay into their host when a site needs it
